in_marathi.name: Tanika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Tanu’, meaning ‘to delight’. In Hindu mythology, Tanika is a name given to the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of wisdom and knowledge. The name symbolizes the feeling of joy and happiness that knowledge and wisdom bring.
